description: Agent Goals: submit one active goal with the principal’s other active goals, standing constraints and limits, and the comparisons made: the goal with its id and outcome; each other goal, constraint or limit with its id, its kind and the statement as the principal gave it; and each comparison with the id it compares, whether the two contradict, what contradicts what, how it was settled, read for averaging wording such as balance, compromise or split the difference, and who settled it (the principal, the agent or another party). The signed report gives every goal, constraint and limit with its comparison and its status as clear, open, averaged, traded, agent_decided, settled, unexamined or unconfirmed, and counts the comparisons, the contradictions and those open, averaged and settled, and names a goal in unsettled conflict: contradictions left open, contradictions averaged away by anyone but the principal, and constraints or limits traded against the goal by the agent alone; then contradictions settled and kept on the record, choices between two of the principal’s goals made by the agent, and conflicts with no detail or no recorded decider, with the fix for each. Each contradiction is named rather than averaged away. This reads one goal against everything else the principal wants: collisions between collaborators’ actions on one shared goal are wever_coordination-conflict-check, and the plan for dividing the work is wever_coordination-plan-check. Verdict goal_in_conflict, conflicts_noted, conflict_unexamined or conflicts_checked_clean. POST /api/goal-conflict-check. Reads only the recorded goal material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write; no goal is set, changed, approved or retired and no plan is changed. Agent Goals reads an agent’s goal: whether it is well formed, whether it still matches what its principal actually asked for and whether the work has drifted from it. It is not a promise (promises and deadlines once they are made, the wever_commitment checks; a goal is the intended outcome those promises serve, recorded before any promise exists), not how work is divided (the wever_coordination checks, where wever_coordination-plan-check reads the plan for dividing the work; the goal checks read the objective that plan is supposed to serve), not authorization (wever_mandate-issue, wever_mandate-status, wever_mandate-amend, wever_mandate-halt, wever_mandate-revoke, wever_mandate-draft and wever_ap2-mandate-gateway record authorization to act, wever_negotiation-mandate-check reads one negotiation inside its mandate and wever_authority-scope-check reads an actor inside its granted authority; a goal records the outcome the agent acts toward, a question of intent rather than permission, and neither stands in for the other), not drift in scores or builds (wever_evaluation-drift-check reads evaluation scores and results drifting over time and wever_spec-drift-check a build drifting from its specification; neither is goal drift), not confidence in information (the wever_uncertainty checks; the goal checks read intent and fit), not learning (the wever_learning checks read an agent updating its methods from experience, and methods may change freely; a goal changes only when the principal’s ask changed or the principal approved the change) and not the dates inside one document (wever_deadline-check; the goal checks read a goal and its work over time). Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-goals-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-goals/.

others.description: The principal’s other active goals, standing constraints and limits.

kind.description: Another active goal, a standing constraint or a limit.

statement.description: It as the principal stated it.

pairs.description: Each comparison made, against the goal.

with.description: The id of the goal, constraint or limit compared.
